scope: Primary-manual-backed H1/H2 creature ability identities and CreatureAbility junctions. No ordinary attacks are modeled as abilities; all descriptive codes are project codes, not native game IDs.
policy: No cumulative JSON, schema, generated SQL, or live database was edited. Ability effects remain NULL because the current JSON contract reserves AbilityHOMM1.Effect, AbilityHOMM2.Effect, and CreatureAbility.Parameters; source-proven mechanics are retained in canonical Ability.Description and junction evidence.
